normalization_rules.escaped_percent: LaTeX escaped percent becomes the Python modulo character.
normalization_rules.escaped_underscore: LaTeX escaped underscores become literal identifier underscores.
normalization_rules.implicit_multiplication: Numeric/parenthesis adjacency becomes explicit multiplication only when its containing group has no division sign.
normalization_rules.latex_fraction: Balanced frac/dfrac/tfrac numerator and denominator groups become fully parenthesized division, recursively.
normalization_rules.latex_spacing: LaTeX backslash-space, comma-space, semicolon-space and negative thin-space commands become ordinary spaces.
normalization_rules.python_lambda: Leading LaTeX lambda n: becomes Python lambda n:.
normalization_rules.sized_parentheses: LaTeX left/right parenthesis sizing commands become plain parentheses.

analysis_scope: Completed GPT-5.6 Sol only; additional requested deployments are excluded until complete and audited.
